properties.name: application.security.jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: JWT token expiration time in milliseconds.

properties.name: application.rate-limiting.enabled
properties.description: Enables or disables application rate limiting.

properties.name: application.rate-limiting.login.limit
properties.description: Maximum login attempts per client within the configured duration.

properties.name: application.rate-limiting.login.duration-in-seconds
properties.description: Login rate limit duration in seconds.

properties.name: application.rate-limiting.register.limit
properties.description: Maximum registration attempts per client within the configured duration.

properties.name: application.rate-limiting.register.duration-in-seconds
properties.description: Registration rate limit duration in seconds.

properties.name: application.rate-limiting.trusted-proxy
properties.description: Enables trusted proxy handling for client IP detection.

properties.name: application.rate-limiting.max-buckets
properties.description: Maximum number of client rate limiting buckets.

properties.name: application.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins.
